notes.title: Our newest game is out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4008416/db4b6199bf57274ed6052363adece00e0b10ca91.jpg

At long last, our newest game is now available! Neo Harbor Rescue Squad brings fresh paramedic action and lets you save lives as a rookie paramedic today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

As we celebrate launch, here are a few key things you'll want to know about the game:

1) It targets 4K/60fps on suitable hardware
Yes, it's our first 4K game! We wanted the bright, colourful artwork and animation to really shine, so on capable systems (see the requirements on the main store page) the game can run up to native 4K resolution. Of course, in the Options menu, you can choose a variety of resolutions in both 16:9 and 16:10 ratios.

2) It's fully localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
Given that vibrant Neo Harbor City is inspired by co-designer Nancy's home town of Hong Kong, we wanted to make the game accessible to our Chinese-speaking friends and family. The localization team managed to even work in some language-specific puns!

3) It was designed with Steam Deck in mind
Neo Harbor Rescue Squad runs at native 1280x800 resolution on Steam Deck and is fully controller-driven there, so if you have one, be sure to give it a go! We also are fans of Valve's portable system, so we wanted to make sure it was ready on day one.

Thanks for all your support so far. If you like the game, please leave a review! And if you have any issues, feel free to report them in the game's Tech Help discussion category.

See you in the field!
- Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Being HOME ALONE WITH YOU is WORSE THAN DEATH!
notes.content:
As we celebrate the upcoming launch of our fourth game, Neo Harbor Rescue Squad, we wanted to collect our first three titles for new and existing players. This bundle is a complete-the-set triple-pack, so if you've not played all of our previous titles, now is a great time to do so at a discounted price.


The games in this bundle

😱 HOME - A UNIQUE HORROR ADVENTURE

https://store.steampowered.com/app/215670/Home/

Awakened by an oncoming storm, you open your eyes to discover yourself in a strange, dark room – tucked away in a house that’s not yours. As you play the game, it changes – subtly, almost imperceptibly – to reflect your perspective. It's a horror game unlike any other, and as you'll discover, its truths are entirely subjective.

🚀 ALONE WITH YOU

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564940/Alone_With_You/

Can love bloom on a doomed space colony? Alone With You is the tragic sci-fi follow-up to indie horror hit Home, in which you discover the fate of your crumbling installation with the help of a very emotive AI companion and four fully-realized holograms. Providing a rich story that adapts to your choices, Alone With You is the Space Quest-meets-OK Cupid adventure game you never knew you wanted – until now!

💀 WORSE THAN DEATH

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029100/Worse_Than_Death/

Run for your life, hide in the shadows, and use your wits to avoid shadowy creatures and uncover the terrible truths of your wretched home town. Solve devious puzzles to reveal the emotionally-charged story of Holly and her friends that will have you hooked until the very end!

Horror, sci-fi, pixel art, and deep storytelling — complete your collection today!

notes.title: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad demo available NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

FINALLY we can show you what we’ve been working on for these last few years! It took a bit longer than we planned, based on our usual game release schedule, but now you can see what we've been cooking!

We would love, love, LOVE for you to give the demo a try. It'll show you about 30 minutes of what the game has to offer — the frantic action, the upbeat humour, and the loveable cast of characters we've created for you. 

> Download it from the game's main page

Some notes about the demo:

A DualSense, DualShock, or Xbox controller is recommended (there's some weirdness with Switch Pro controllers right now that will be fixed)
The demo can be played in up to native 4K!
There may be some weirdness with windowed mode right now; we'll fix that too
The demo lets you fail treatment scenes with no penalty; we just want you to have fun; you can stress out in the full game


We made a wholesome game!?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4008416/7ac4b21d936e8bcb70ed4afc291616b5aa6d9842.png

We're super excited that Neo Harbor Rescue Squad joins the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration. 🎉

For those who’ve played our previous games, you’ll notice a change in tone, and there’s a reason for that.
This game was conceived during the height of the pandemic. Initially, we were going to channel that into a dark mystery, just like our other games, but we struggled to make it fun. Maybe it was because neither of us had the mental capacity during those uncertain times. Eventually, we tried a different angle. We added a cast of colorful characters, including a smack-talking dolphin (don’t ask); that’s when we knew we’d hit the right note. 

So please enjoy this demo! Tell your friends, smack that wishlist button, etc. etc. — and thanks for your continued support. 🙏

Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Announcing our new game: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=PMFicJOCIxU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, everyone! We can at long last can announce our fourth original game, Neo Harbor Rescue Squad!

This arcade-style action title fuses the mechanics of popular medical-themed games from the Wii and DS era with fast-paced, challenging minigames so you get a taste of being a paramedic. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4008416/fe695d3e3f19261a933eecaed0d138cb2d1b6bf5.gif

The Rescue Squad has long lived in the shadow of the Neo Harbor City's prestigious Fire Department, but no more! As the team's new paramedic rookie, players must respond to emergencies throughout the city, deal with difficult patients, and protect the squad's reputation against the machinations of news reporter Betty Woo!

Notable features:

 🩹 Use our triage system to quickly monitor patients’ health, how much damage they’re taking, if they’re critical, and learn to prioritize treatment
 🪟 Quickly switch between different views to manage multiple patients across a variety of complex scenes
 🛡️ Use shields to temporarily protect your patients from damage, giving you some breathing room to strategize
 🅰️ Aim for a high rank with each emergency; be graded based on speed, skill, and the condition of your patients
 💬 Make dialogue choices to deal with the public, advance the story, and get to know your squadmates
 🐬 Laugh through a story of teamwork and friendship (and dolphins), inspired by real paramedic stories in Asia!
 👀 Be a paramedic in up to native 4K!


Sounds exciting? Then wishlist the game today! 🙏 Your support means a lot to us and helps us reach more players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

Curious about how/why we decided to make a paramedic action game? We'll be posting behind-the-scenes updates about our development process up until launch.

Thank you!
Ben + Nancy (BancyCo)

notes.title: Worse Than Death launches October 8!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4008416/b295393ed8f1b54ab8a1c68324381fb9925c0622.jpg

Yes, horror fans! We've been stoked to tell you this for months now. Since announcing Worse Than Death back in February, we launched the game on iOS and then worked to get it tip-top for PC and consoles. 

And finally we can announce that the game launches here on October 8 — that's next week!

In its glowing review, the Los Angeles Times labeled Worse Than Death “a game with ‘Stranger Things’ vibes,” and TouchArcade called it “an incredible experience,” awarding it 4.5 out of 5 stars and listing it as one of July’s best games. The App Store itself proclaimed Worse Than Death Game of the Day, calling it, “stunning, spooky and deep.”

Some reminders on Steam features:

 three difficulty modes (Normal, Hard and Nightmare)
 29 achievements to keep you playing in interesting ways and scouring for secrets
 Steam cloud support
 hot-swap between keyboard/mouse and controller anytime


If you're excited, you can wishlist the game right here. And remember: we're a tiny mom-and-pop studio; if you think some friends would be into WTD, please tell them!

notes.title: UPDATE - v1.6.0 provides a big overhaul!
notes.content:
Holy crap, people — did you realize that Home is almost five years old!? And you continue to play, question, debate and enjoy it, which brings many a smile to our weathered faces.

Home gets a lot of under-the-hood improvements today, to make your playing experience better, and to future-proof the game as new players continue to discover it and dive in.

What's New in v1.6.0
- Home now more seamlessly supports keyboard, mouse, Xinput gamepads and (NEW) PlayStation®4 DualShock®4 controllers; plug whatever you have in and use it; the game will adjust its prompts to match more accurately
- Home is now fully playable with a mouse/trackpad (except for that one puzzle that requires typing)
- new pause menu allows you to return to title screen or quit to desktop
- game now renders beautifully on 21:9 monitors!

Bug fixes and improvements
- tweaked, higher-res, better-looking title and ending screens
- gamepads no longer rumble if not actively in use
- screenshots now work consistently *
- better window mode switching (just hit F4)
- text boxes can no longer be skipped by accident! 
- locked doors consistently display "now unlocked" text
- a bunch of little "how is that still a thing?" fixes

* Mac version sometimes takes "partial screenshots" — we are trying to find a way around this and will address this in a future update.

A message to the players
We still can't believe how popular this game got since its launch, and how many of you have jumped in to try our brand of horror-mystery-adventure. We just wanted to say thanks for all the support these past years — we hope you'll continue to enjoy Home, and our other games.

:-)
Ben

notes.title: UPDATE - Home v1.5.0 supports HD resolutions and more
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for continuing to play Home and discuss the game. 

Today's update (for PC and Mac) adds a few new things:

• proper 16:9 widescreen support (will look great on your TV!)
• main titles now support 720p and 1080p resolutions
• improved controls for Xinput controllers; see below
• various bug fixes and tweaks (especially for Mac)

About the updated controls
With an Xbox 360 or Xbox One controller, you can now use "X" to progress through text, instead of having to press down on the analogue stick. It's a little change, but it improves things quite a bit.

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Home Product Update
notes.content:
What’s New:
• Home now fully supports Steam’s Big Picture Mode – play the entire game with your Xbox 360 controller from the terrifying comfort of your own couch, or continue to use a keyboard if you prefer.

• The most requested feature has been added to the game! Home now auto-saves your progress as you play, allowing for shorter play sessions if required. Continue where you left off, or start over from the beginning. The game still starts you from the beginning once you complete it, though—keeping the integrity of the experience while adding convenience for players who need it.

• Some things may not always be what they seem. As promised in previous missives, players may start to see their Home experience change ever so slightly the next time they play. Was that room there before? I thought that was locked... This is just the beginning for long-term fans of the game.

• Various other graphical tweaks and corrections to text and menus.
